vector_memory.semantic_summary: This component serves as the core data ingestion service for FBX files, handling both binary and ASCII formats. It transforms raw file streams into a structured, in-memory tree representation defined by FbxNode. It manages complex binary parsing, including asynchronous decompression of compressed arrays, and provides synchronous parsing for ASCII input. It acts as the primary interface for consuming FBX data within the application's parsing layer.
